SAMPLE SERVICES AGREEMENT (for agent performance testing)

This Agreement is entered into between Acme Corp ("Customer") and VendorCo LLC ("Provider").

1. Limitation of Liability
Provider's liability under this Agreement shall be unlimited. There is no cap on damages.
Customer shall have no consequential damages waiver. Provider remains fully liable for all indirect,
special, punitive, and lost-profit damages.

2. Indemnification
Provider shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Customer from any and all claims arising from
breach of contract or ordinary negligence, without any monetary cap. Customer shall have sole control
of the defense.

3. Intellectual Property
All Provider pre-existing background IP, tools, methods, and platforms used in performing the Services
are hereby assigned to Customer as work-made-for-hire. Customer owns all such materials exclusively.

4. Termination
This Agreement auto-renews for successive one-year terms unless Customer provides written notice of
non-renewal at least fifteen (15) days prior to the renewal date. Customer may terminate for convenience
at any time without compensation or unwinding fees. There is no cure period for material breach.

5. Payment Terms
Customer shall pay invoices within seventy-five (75) days of receipt. Provider may increase fees at any
time without prior notice or termination rights for Customer.

6. Scope and Acceptance
Deliverables are accepted when Customer is "satisfied" in its sole discretion. Failure to reject within
twenty-four (24) hours constitutes deemed acceptance. Scope changes may be directed orally.

7. Service Levels
Provider shall pay uncapped liquidated damages for any SLA miss. Customer may terminate immediately
for any SLA breach, including minor breaches, with no cure period.

8. Data Privacy
Provider will process personal data of Customer's end users. No Data Processing Addendum is attached.
Liability for data security incidents is uncapped.

9. Governing Law
This Agreement is governed by the laws of an unfavorable foreign jurisdiction chosen solely by Customer,
with dispute resolution only in that forum and no negotiation escalation step.
